ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Critical Intervention — NeoTerran Command — REVISED
ObjectStates.Description:
Drop this bag on STAGE > DROP BAGS HERE to deploy. Use the stage CLEAR TABLE button to remove the whole map, including changed building states.

Critical Intervention / NeoTerran Command
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.
Defender is south by default; room walls count as infinite height. Review room bounds, four Wide Gates, corner antenna contact and turret positions in TTS. Exclusion zone applies to Attacker.
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/5b283069-90e5-4477-b7a5-c424ef30daa4
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.
Placement and cloud-ad audit fixes: 27 October 2026. Corrected vertical contact; layout retained.

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Assetbundle
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- Immediate static lock: preserve scenery before physics can resolve stacked colliders.
local originalOnLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 self.setLock(true)
 if originalOnLoad then originalOnLoad(saved) end
end

-- Uniform stage cleanup, including objects with changed state GUIDs.
function onDestroy()
 local key="loboClearing:100544"
 if Global.getVar(key) then return end
 Global.setVar(key,true)
 local doomed={}
 for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
  if o~=self and o.hasTag("LoboMap:100544") then doomed[#doomed+1]=o end
 end
 for _,o in ipairs(doomed) do o.destruct() end
 Global.setVar(key,false)
end

-- BEGIN LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1
-- Rendered model bounds already include the object's current scale.
-- Project the normalized renderer bounds onto vertical; world elevation is irrelevant.
local loboHeightTimer=nil
local loboHeightPrefix='Height (base to top): '
local function loboHeightBody(description)
 local s=description or ''
 if string.sub(s,1,#loboHeightPrefix)==loboHeightPrefix then
  local e=string.find(s,'\n',1,true)
  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)
 if not ok or not bounds or not bounds.size then return false end
 local size=bounds.size
 if not size.x or not size.y or not size.z then return false end
 local right,up,forward=self.getTransformRight(),self.getTransformUp(),self.getTransformForward()
 local height=math.abs(right.y)*size.x+math.abs(up.y)*size.y+math.abs(forward.y)*size.z
 if height~=height or height<=0.001 or height==math.huge then return false end
 local description=loboHeightPrefix..string.format('%.2f in',height)
 local body=loboHeightBody(self.getDescription())
 if body~='' then description=description..'\n'..body end
 if self.getDescription()~=description then self.setDescription(description) end
 self.tooltip=true
 return true
end
local function loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightTimer then Wait.stop(loboHeightTimer);loboHeightTimer=nil end
end
local function loboHeightBegin()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightRefresh() then return end
 local tries=0
 loboHeightTimer=Wait.time(function()
  tries=tries+1
  if self.isDestroyed() or loboHeightRefresh() or tries>=90 then loboHeightStop() end
 end,1,90)
end
local loboHeightPreviousLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboHeightPreviousLoad then loboHeightPreviousLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousState=onStateChange
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 if loboHeightPreviousState then loboHeightPreviousState(oldGuid) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousHover=onHover
function onHover(color)
 if loboHeightPreviousHover then loboHeightPreviousHover(color) end
 loboHeightRefresh()
end
local loboHeightPreviousDestroy=onDestroy
function onDestroy()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightPreviousDestroy then loboHeightPreviousDestroy() end
end
-- END LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1

-- Project the normalized renderer bounds onto vertical; world elevation is irrelevant.
local loboHeightTimer=nil
local loboHeightPrefix='Height (base to top): '
local function loboHeightBody(description)
 local s=description or ''
 if string.sub(s,1,#loboHeightPrefix)==loboHeightPrefix then
  local e=string.find(s,'\n',1,true)
  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)
 if not ok or not bounds or not bounds.size then return false end
 local size=bounds.size
 if not size.x or not size.y or not size.z then return false end
 local right,up,forward=self.getTransformRight(),self.getTransformUp(),self.getTransformForward()
 local height=math.abs(right.y)*size.x+math.abs(up.y)*size.y+math.abs(forward.y)*size.z
 if height~=height or height<=0.001 or height==math.huge then return false end
 local description=loboHeightPrefix..string.format('%.2f in',height)
 local body=loboHeightBody(self.getDescription())
 if body~='' then description=description..'\n'..body end
 if self.getDescription()~=description then self.setDescription(description) end
 self.tooltip=true
 return true
end
local function loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightTimer then Wait.stop(loboHeightTimer);loboHeightTimer=nil end
end
local function loboHeightBegin()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightRefresh() then return end
 local tries=0
 loboHeightTimer=Wait.time(function()
  tries=tries+1
  if self.isDestroyed() or loboHeightRefresh() or tries>=90 then loboHeightStop() end
 end,1,90)
end
local loboHeightPreviousLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboHeightPreviousLoad then loboHeightPreviousLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousState=onStateChange
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 if loboHeightPreviousState then loboHeightPreviousState(oldGuid) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousHover=onHover

 loboHeightRefresh()
end

function onDestroy()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightPreviousDestroy then loboHeightPreviousDestroy() end

-- Immediate static lock: preserve scenery before physics can resolve stacked colliders.
local originalOnLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 self.setLock(true)
 if originalOnLoad then originalOnLoad(saved) end
end

-- BEGIN LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1
-- Rendered model bounds already include the object's current scale.
-- Project the normalized renderer bounds onto vertical; world elevation is irrelevant.
local loboHeightTimer=nil
local loboHeightPrefix='Height (base to top): '
local function loboHeightBody(description)
 local s=description or ''
 if string.sub(s,1,#loboHeightPrefix)==loboHeightPrefix then
  local e=string.find(s,'\n',1,true)
  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)
 if not ok or not bounds or not bounds.size then return false end
 local size=bounds.size
 if not size.x or not size.y or not size.z then return false end
 local right,up,forward=self.getTransformRight(),self.getTransformUp(),self.getTransformForward()
 local height=math.abs(right.y)*size.x+math.abs(up.y)*size.y+math.abs(forward.y)*size.z
 if height~=height or height<=0.001 or height==math.huge then return false end
 local description=loboHeightPrefix..string.format('%.2f in',height)
 local body=loboHeightBody(self.getDescription())
 if body~='' then description=description..'\n'..body end
 if self.getDescription()~=description then self.setDescription(description) end
 self.tooltip=true
 return true
end
local function loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightTimer then Wait.stop(loboHeightTimer);loboHeightTimer=nil end
end
local function loboHeightBegin()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightRefresh() then return end
 local tries=0
 loboHeightTimer=Wait.time(function()
  tries=tries+1
  if self.isDestroyed() or loboHeightRefresh() or tries>=90 then loboHeightStop() end
 end,1,90)
end
local loboHeightPreviousLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboHeightPreviousLoad then loboHeightPreviousLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousState=onStateChange
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 if loboHeightPreviousState then loboHeightPreviousState(oldGuid) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousHover=onHover
function onHover(color)
 if loboHeightPreviousHover then loboHeightPreviousHover(color) end
 loboHeightRefresh()
end
local loboHeightPreviousDestroy=onDestroy
function onDestroy()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightPreviousDestroy then loboHeightPreviousDestroy() end
end
-- END LOBO BASE-TO-TOP HEIGHT V1

local current = 0;

adconfig = {
    ADTIME = {6,10},
    INITIALDISPLAY = "random",
}

local anim = 0;
local current = 0;

function randomAd()
    if (#adList > 0) then
        math.randomseed(os.time() + self.guid:byte())
        current = math.random(1, #adList)
        for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
            if (i ~= current) then
                self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
            end
        end
        self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
        anim = Wait.time(randomAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
    end
end

function sequenceAd()
    if (#adList > 0) then
        math.randomseed(os.time() + self.guid:byte())
        current = current + 1
        if (current > #adList) then
            current = 1
        end
        for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
            if (i ~= current) then
                self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
            end
        end
        self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
        anim = Wait.time(sequenceAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
    end
end

function displayRandom()
    Wait.stop(anim)
    math.randomseed(os.time() + self.guid:byte())
    current = math.random(1, #adList)
    for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
        if (current ~= i) then
            self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
        end
    end
    self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
    anim = Wait.time(randomAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
end

function displaySequence()
    Wait.stop(anim)
    current = 1
    for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
        if (i ~= current) then
            self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
        end
    end
    self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
    anim = Wait.time(sequenceAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
end

function rebuildUI()

    local scoreChildren = {}

    table.insert(scoreChildren, {
            tag="Panel", attributes={
                width=3600/3.5,
                height=6400/3.5,
                position="0 100 1100",

                        width="800",

                        outline="black",

                    }
                },
                {
                    tag="Text",
                    attributes={
                        color=adconfig.P1_COLOR,
                        id="score_player1_value",
                        text="-",

                    }
                }
            }
    })

    local ui = {
        {
            tag="Panel",

                position="0 0 0",
                id="score",
                active=false,
                showAnimation="Grow",
                hideAnimation="Shrink",

            },
            children = scoreChildren
        }
    }

    local assets = {}
    local assetRefs = {}
    local refLen = 0
    for i,url in pairs(adList) do
        if (assetRefs[url] == nil) then
            refLen = refLen + 1
            assetRefs[url] = self.guid.."_ad_"..refLen
            table.insert(assets, {name=assetRefs[url], url=url})
        end

        table.insert(ui, {
            tag="Panel", children={
                {
                    tag="Image",
                    attributes={
                        color="#ffffffc0",
                        image=(assetRefs[url]),
                        width=3600/3.5,
                        height=6400/3.5,
                        position="0 100 1100",
                        rotation="260 0 0",
                    }
                }
            }, attributes={
                position="0 0 0",
                id=("ad_"..i),
                active=false,
                showAnimation="Grow",
                hideAnimation="Shrink",
                animationDuration=1.0
            }

    self.UI.setAttribute("score_player2_name", "text", TRH['score_p2n'] or "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("score_player2_value", "text", TRH['score_p2v'] or "-")
end

function onSave()
    local component = self.getComponent("MeshCollider") or self.getComponent("BoxCollider")

-- Rendered model bounds already include the object's current scale.
-- Project the normalized renderer bounds onto vertical; world elevation is irrelevant.
local loboHeightTimer=nil
local loboHeightPrefix='Height (base to top): '
local function loboHeightBody(description)
 local s=description or ''
 if string.sub(s,1,#loboHeightPrefix)==loboHeightPrefix then
  local e=string.find(s,'\n',1,true)
  return e and string.sub(s,e+1) or ''
 end
 return s
end
local function loboHeightRefresh()
 if self.isDestroyed() or self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,bounds=pcall(function() return self.getVisualBoundsNormalized() end)
 if not ok or not bounds or not bounds.size then return false end
 local size=bounds.size
 if not size.x or not size.y or not size.z then return false end
 local right,up,forward=self.getTransformRight(),self.getTransformUp(),self.getTransformForward()
 local height=math.abs(right.y)*size.x+math.abs(up.y)*size.y+math.abs(forward.y)*size.z
 if height~=height or height<=0.001 or height==math.huge then return false end
 local description=loboHeightPrefix..string.format('%.2f in',height)
 local body=loboHeightBody(self.getDescription())
 if body~='' then description=description..'\n'..body end
 if self.getDescription()~=description then self.setDescription(description) end
 self.tooltip=true
 return true
end
local function loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightTimer then Wait.stop(loboHeightTimer);loboHeightTimer=nil end
end
local function loboHeightBegin()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightRefresh() then return end
 local tries=0
 loboHeightTimer=Wait.time(function()
  tries=tries+1
  if self.isDestroyed() or loboHeightRefresh() or tries>=90 then loboHeightStop() end
 end,1,90)
end

function onLoad(saved)
 if loboHeightPreviousLoad then loboHeightPreviousLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousState=onStateChange
function onStateChange(oldGuid)
 if loboHeightPreviousState then loboHeightPreviousState(oldGuid) end
 Wait.frames(loboHeightBegin,2)
end
local loboHeightPreviousHover=onHover
function onHover(color)
 if loboHeightPreviousHover then loboHeightPreviousHover(color) end
 loboHeightRefresh()
end
local loboHeightPreviousDestroy=onDestroy
function onDestroy()
 loboHeightStop()
 if loboHeightPreviousDestroy then loboHeightPreviousDestroy() end
end

-- Universal DZ compositor: preserve mission lines while owning deployment visibility.
local function loboUniversalWrite(target,lines)
 if target.getGUID()=="1005cd" then
  local owner=getObjectFromGUID("668a98")
  if owner and not owner.isDestroyed() then
   local ok,handled=pcall(function()return owner.call('loboUniversalSetBase',{guid=target.getGUID(),lines=lines})end)
   if ok and handled then return end
  end
 end
 target.setVectorLines(lines)
end
-- BEGIN LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2
-- Every colored centerline remains at its exact measured X/Z coordinates.
local function loboContrastDraw(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local strokes={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {}) do
  if line.points and #line.points>1 then
   local width=math.max((tonumber(line.thickness) or .015)*1.5,.065)
   local border,core={},{}
   for k,v in pairs(line) do border[k]=v;core[k]=v end
   border.color={.006,.009,.014}
   border.thickness=width+.085
   core.thickness=width
   local c=line.color or {1,1,1}
   local r,g,b=c.r or c[1] or 1,c.g or c[2] or 1,c.b or c[3] or 1
   local maximum=math.max(r,g,b,.001)
   r,g,b=r/maximum,g/maximum,b/maximum
   if b>r*1.5 and b>g then g=math.max(g,.82);r=math.min(r,.18)
   elseif r>b*1.5 and r>=g then
    if g>.7 then g=math.max(g,.95);b=math.min(b,.12)
    else g=math.max(g,.55);b=math.min(b,.16) end
   end
   core.color={r,g,b}
   core.points={}
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points) do
    local world=target.positionToWorld(Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3]))
    world.y=world.y+.004
    local q=target.positionToLocal(world)
    core.points[#core.points+1]={q.x,q.y,q.z}
   end
   strokes[#strokes+1]=border
   strokes[#strokes+1]=core
  end
 end
 loboUniversalWrite(target,strokes)
end
-- END LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2

 if saved and saved~=''then
  local ok,state=pcall(function()return JSON.decode(saved)end)

   for _,offset in ipairs({0,4,8})do universalEnabled[offset]=state.loboUniversal[tostring(offset)]==true end
  end
 end

end

 state.loboUniversal={};for _,offset in ipairs({0,4,8})do state.loboUniversal[tostring(offset)]=universalEnabled[offset]end
 return JSON.encode(state)
end
